summary: Which generation path runs. image-to-image additionally requires image and strength.
combines: aspect_ratio is ignored in image-to-image mode.

usage.code: routingMode chooses a direct endpoint; Bedrock sends body.mode as text-to-image or image-to-image
usage.from: the count and roles of resolved image references
usage.what: Selects text-to-image or a reference-driven route without exposing provider routing as a user setting. The typed image.generate pipeline operation uses one Bedrock text-to-image request with durable authorization, native-result persistence, and a stable output slot. Pipeline image authorization and usage identify the synchronized provider modelVersion, while operation metadata and Asset lineage retain the canonical provider:model selection ID.

note: Derived from the resolved reference-routing mode.
